question: Since which year has the Census become a regular ten yearly exercise in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1881**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first synchronized census in India was conducted in 1881 under the British rule.
 
• Since 1881, censuses have been carried out every ten years without any disruptions.
 
• The census operation is one of the largest administrative exercises in the world.
 
• It provides comprehensive data on the population, housing, economic activities, social and cultural aspects, and demographic characteristics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decennial Census:**

 
 
• The decennial census provides critical data for planning and policy-making at all levels of government.
 
• The census data is used for the delimitation of constituencies and allocation of representation to Parliament and state legislative assemblies.
 
 
 
• **Registrar General and Census Commissioner:**
 
 
• The office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, is responsible for conducting the Census.
 
• This office is also responsible for the registration of births and deaths in the country.
 
 
 
• **Technology in Census:**
 
 
• Recent censuses have increasingly incorporated technology to improve data collection, processing, and dissemination.
 
• The 2021 Census is expected to use mobile apps for data collection for the first time.
 
 
 
• **Uses of Census Data:**
 
 
• Census data is vital for monitoring and evaluating government programs and initiatives.
 
• It provides a basis for various socio-economic research and analysis.
